notes: Material document header for goods receipts against purchase orders -- closes the middle of the purchasing cycle (PO -> GR -> invoice verification, whose RBKP/RSEG legs are already mapped). FKs verified clean before mapping: 0 null PO_ID, every PO reference resolves against Purchase Orders, and every Goods Receipt Lines header resolves here. MJAHR (material document year, part of MKPF's key) is deliberately not emitted -- same reasoning as RBKP-GJAHR: deriving it requires fiscal-year-variant logic and the target assigns it at posting. No vendor on the header target: MKPF has no LIFNR field -- the vendor is implied by the PO reference carried on the MSEG items.
